en.over_monthly_budget: This month's spending on AI and search has reached about {spent:money}, the limit of {limit:money}, so I'll stop answering for this month.
en.over_research_daily: Today's research has already cost about {spent:money} (limit {limit:money}). Let's continue tomorrow.
en.over_search_daily: I've already searched {used} times today (limit {limit}). Let's search again tomorrow.
en.ledger_unavailable: I can't read or update the spending ledger right now, so I can't confirm how much has been spent this month. To stay under the limit, I won't answer for now.
en.model_unavailable: I can't reach the cloud AI right now, so I can't answer. It's {time}. Let's talk again once I'm back online.
en.over_monthly_budget_raisable: This month's spending on AI and search has reached about {spent:money}, the limit of {limit:money}, so I'll stop answering until the 1st of next month. If you want to raise the limit by {raise:money} for now, just tell me.
en.confirm_cap_raise: Do you want to raise this month's limit by {raise:money} for now?
en.monthly_cap_raised: Okay, this month's limit is now {limit:money}. You can keep going.
en.over_account_monthly: Your spending this month has reached about {spent:money}, the limit of {limit:money} set by the admin, so I'll stop answering for this month. Ask the admin to raise the limit to keep going.
